name: accumulator_width_and_loop_topology

methodology.quality_metric: exact RTL simulation of the accumulator trajectory (4M steps, same semantics as ternary_mac_synth.v)
methodology.note: No Vivado: AMD account login required and the host has 3.9 GiB free. Same synthesis flow that produced the shipped .bit.

baseline.quality: peak |acc_out| = 127 -> 8-bit signed SUFFICIENT; the 32-bit register is pruned to the bits that can change

controlled_change.factor_2: loop topology: open (acc_in=0) vs closed (acc_in=acc_out, a true running accumulator)
controlled_change.hypothesis: narrowing the accumulator saves LUTs/FFs/carry chains; if the quality metric allows it, adopt the narrowest safe width

measurements.verdict: correct; saves 1 LUT and 1 FF only - not worth the narrowing risk
ACCEPT: the only width that is correct for a true running accumulator (needs 21 bits signed)
REJECT: -37% LCs but overflows on 4.06M of 4.19M steps

scaling_law_measured.interpretation: In closed loop every extra 8 accumulator bits costs ~6 LUTs and ~8 FFs (the adder carry chain). In open loop the upper bits are provably constant and cost nothing, so 16b and 32b are identical.

decision_rationale: Zero-DSP ternary MAC holds across all eight configurations (DSP48E1 = 0 everywhere).
Zero-BRAM holds across all eight configurations (BRAM36 = 0 everywhere): the 2-bit weight code is a LUT mux, not a memory.

Narrowing the closed-loop accumulator from 32b to 16b saves 15 LCs (-37%) and 16 FFs, but the measured accumulator peak is 1,048,671, which needs 21 signed bits. The saving is rejected because it breaks correctness.
The 4-bit open-loop configuration saves 6 LCs but overflows on 47% of steps: rejected.
Open-loop 16b is cost-identical to 32b, so the declared 32-bit width is kept: no cost, no risk.
next_iteration: closed-loop accumulator -> attention + bounded KV-cache; measure the KV BRAM cost and the added latency, and re-check the accumulator peak with the attention path present

power.note: Resource delta is MEASURED; W is still an estimate pending Vivado report_power or an external meter.
